# Knowledge base

_No features registered yet._

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/config-in-kb-yaml-model-in-code` — Repository values live in a strict kb.yaml at the root the tool walks up to; the record model and generated-file grammar are code. (accepted, 2026-10-08) → `docs/adr/config-in-kb-yaml-model-in-code.md`
- `kb:adr/roles-checked-against-an-agents-directory` — With agents.dir set, check ties the role list to the agent files, one <name>.md each, through aliases, session roles and agentless files named in the config. (accepted, 2026-10-08) → `docs/adr/roles-checked-against-an-agents-directory.md`
- `kb:adr/touches-pack-as-spec-and-contract` — Touches names features a plan edits without changing; they pack as spec and contract only, except for configured roles, and kb scope can widen the header. (accepted, 2026-10-08) → `docs/adr/touches-pack-as-spec-and-contract.md`
- `kb:adr/version-record-is-a-plain-text-file` — A fact's verified range is checked against a plain-text version record the config names, one version, date and note per row, plus a configurable ceiling word. (accepted, 2026-10-08) → `docs/adr/version-record-is-a-plain-text-file.md`
- `kb:adr/yaml-parsed-strictly-with-goccy` — kb.yaml is decoded by github.com/goccy/go-yaml in strict mode; record frontmatter keeps the hand-rolled flat scanner. (accepted, 2026-10-08) → `docs/adr/yaml-parsed-strictly-with-goccy.md`
